name: elbakri-operations
description: ELBAKRI OVERSEAS — Booking, Operations & Finance Management System

scripts.build: npm run build -w @elbakri/shared && npm run build -w @elbakri/api && npm run build -w @elbakri/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @elbakri/shared && npm run build -w @elbakri/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @elbakri/shared && npm run build -w @elbakri/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @elbakri/api" "npm run dev -w @elbakri/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @elbakri/shared && npm run test -w @elbakri/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @elbakri/api && npm run lint -w @elbakri/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @elbakri/shared && npm run typecheck -w @elbakri/api && npm run typecheck -w @elbakri/web
